Forward-funding signal for BWXT is therefore not testable in the current Signal OS framework — usaspending provides only rear-view contract confirmation. This finding is a META-OBSERVATION on framework coverage: BWXT is exactly the kind of company where the J-Book + DOE-Office-of-Science combo cannot speak to the forward thesis.
